_note: Concept A dialogue (en). t = spoken (numbers as words), sub = subtitle, en = English subtitle; to / glance / gesture from the scenario table.

nar_open.t: Rukn Toy Company is having a hard year. There are more proposals on the table than the team can deliver. You lead the turnaround, and you have eight units of execution capacity for this cycle.
nar_open.en: Rukn Toy Company is having a hard year. There are more proposals on the table than the team can deliver. You lead the turnaround, and you have eight units of execution capacity for this cycle.

victor_hello.t: Take your time at the table. When you are done, I want a clear order, a named risk and a review condition.
victor_hello.en: Take your time at the table. When you are done, I want a clear order, a named risk and a review condition.

rania_open.t: Our retailer is asking for regular delivery of the line that customers already buy.
rania_open.en: Our retailer is asking for regular delivery of the line that customers already buy.

rania_note.t: This is the retailer's report on stock and demand. Read it before you decide.
rania_note.en: This is the retailer's report on stock and demand. Read it before you decide.

ina_open.t: A new theme could bring in families who pass our current shelf.
ina_open.en: A new theme could bring in families who pass our current shelf.

mikael_open.t: Each proposal takes people away from something else. You have eight units of capacity this cycle.
mikael_open.en: Each proposal takes people away from something else. You have eight units of capacity this cycle.

ina_to_mikael.t: But if we don't try something new now, then when?
ina_to_mikael.en: But if we don't try something new now, then when?

mikael_to_ina.t: When we can staff it without pulling people off delivery.
mikael_to_ina.en: When we can staff it without pulling people off delivery.

rania_to_both.t: And the retailer won't wait. An empty shelf goes to someone else.
rania_to_both.en: And the retailer won't wait. An empty shelf goes to someone else.

mikael_task.t: Open all four proposals first, and read the retailer's report. Then we allocate the units.
mikael_task.en: Open all four proposals first, and read the retailer's report. Then we allocate the units.

q_core.t: This line already sells, and its parts are familiar to our customers. Four units keep its team fully staffed.
q_core.en: This line already sells, and its parts are familiar to our customers. Four units keep its team fully staffed.

q_delivery.t: The retailer finds the shelf empty one week and full the next. With two units we name an availability owner and steady supply.
q_delivery.en: The retailer finds the shelf empty one week and full the next. With two units we name an availability owner and steady supply.

q_theme.t: The idea is promising, but no customer has tried it yet. Three units give us a small pilot and a decision after it.
q_theme.en: The idea is promising, but no customer has tried it yet. Three units give us a small pilot and a decision after it.

q_venue.t: A place where families come to build with us. It reaches people who never walk into a retail store.
q_venue.en: A place where families come to build with us. It reaches people who never walk into a retail store.

q_venue2.t: But it needs a long lead time and a whole new operating model. Five units, and a commitment after that.
q_venue2.en: But it needs a long lead time and a whole new operating model. Five units, and a commitment after that.

rania_tag_wrong.t: It isn't untested demand. The report is about our existing range, and customers ask for it by name.
rania_tag_wrong.en: It isn't untested demand. The report is about our existing range, and customers ask for it by name.

rania_tag_ok.t: Right. The demand is there. The problem is that the goods are not always on the shelf.
rania_tag_ok.en: Right. The demand is there. The problem is that the goods are not always on the shelf.

mikael_alloc.t: Nothing is funded yet. Take units from the rack and press them onto the base of what you will fund. You can return them any time.
mikael_alloc.en: Nothing is funded yet. Take units from the rack and press them onto the base of what you will fund. You can return them any time.

mikael_refuse.t: It doesn't fit. For this to go in, something else has to wait.
mikael_refuse.en: It doesn't fit. For this to go in, something else has to wait.

f_core.t: Good. Our current line has its team.
f_core.en: Good. Our current line has its team.

f_delivery.t: I'll name an availability owner tomorrow.
f_delivery.en: I'll name an availability owner tomorrow.

f_theme.t: A small pilot is enough to learn.
f_theme.en: A small pilot is enough to learn.

f_venue.t: Five units into long work. We'll need another decision later.
f_venue.en: Five units into long work. We'll need another decision later.

mikael_order.t: You funded two. Which starts first? Put the two cards in the priority tray.
mikael_order.en: You funded two. Which starts first? Put the two cards in the priority tray.

ina_need.t: And what waits? Name one need you didn't fund, so it doesn't get lost.
ina_need.en: And what waits? Name one need you didn't fund, so it doesn't get lost.

mikael_receipt.t: This is what gets done, and this is what waits. Every line has a consequence.
mikael_receipt.en: This is what gets done, and this is what waits. Every line has a consequence.

victor_q.t: What happens first? What condition would make you change the plan?
victor_q.en: What happens first? What condition would make you change the plan?

victor_single.t: One proposal, so it comes first. Then tell me what waits, and the review condition.
victor_single.en: One proposal, so it comes first. Then tell me what waits, and the review condition.

victor_m_core.t: The plan protects the existing range and gives us a point to revisit.
victor_m_core.en: The plan protects the existing range and gives us a point to revisit.

victor_m_delivery.t: We can see whether delivery improved before adding work.
victor_m_delivery.en: We can see whether delivery improved before adding work.

victor_m_theme.t: The trial has a gate before we carry the full cost.
victor_m_theme.en: The trial has a gate before we carry the full cost.

victor_m_venue.t: You have named the condition for taking on the larger commitment.
victor_m_venue.en: You have named the condition for taking on the larger commitment.

victor_other.t: That condition doesn't test what you put first.
victor_other.en: That condition doesn't test what you put first.

victor_spend.t: Spending the remaining units right away is not a review condition. What will you watch?
victor_spend.en: Spending the remaining units right away is not a review condition. What will you watch?

victor_first_changed.t: The first proposal changed, so pick a new review condition.
victor_first_changed.en: The first proposal changed, so pick a new review condition.

player_pitch.t: This is my plan: what starts first, what waits by name, and a condition to review it.
player_pitch.en: This is my plan: what starts first, what waits by name, and a condition to review it.

victor_commit.t: Thank you. I'll keep this copy as it is. Now let's open the archive on the wall.
victor_commit.en: Thank you. I'll keep this copy as it is. Now let's open the archive on the wall.

nar_archive1.t: This is a real archive. In its two thousand and four annual report, the LEGO Group described an action plan with three themes.
nar_archive1.sub: This is a real archive. In its 2004 annual report, the LEGO Group described an action plan with three themes.
nar_archive1.en: This is a real archive. In its 2004 annual report, the LEGO Group described an action plan with three themes.

nar_archive2.t: LEGO refocused on core products, worked on customer and operating performance, and reduced its exposure to some activities and assets. Its financial report describes a return to profit in two thousand and five.
nar_archive2.sub: LEGO refocused on core products, worked on customer and operating performance, and reduced its exposure to some activities and assets. Its financial report describes a return to profit in 2005.
nar_archive2.en: LEGO refocused on core products, worked on customer and operating performance, and reduced its exposure to some activities and assets. Its financial report describes a return to profit in 2005.

nar_archive3.t: The report shows several linked changes and an overall result, not one card. That is why each proposed change is tested with a defined review condition.
nar_archive3.en: The report shows several linked changes and an overall result, not one card. That is why each proposed change is tested with a defined review condition.

victor_end.t: Your plan stays as you committed it. Compare it, and try another allocation if you like.
victor_end.en: Your plan stays as you committed it. Compare it, and try another allocation if you like.
